text:
Type: crescent moon wall lamp
Use: night light and decoration on a wall; children's room, nursery
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: yellow translucent plastic shade, white cord with inline switch
Colors: bright warm yellow, white
Shape: large flat crescent moon outline with smooth rounded tips, glows evenly when lit, hangs against the wall, playful and bold
Feel: cheerful, cozy, playful, dreamy
Goes with: blue or white walls, star decorations, colourful textiles; children's rooms and nurseries
